requirements.expected_failure_mode: files are chosen by extension, or a non-DICOM file stops the run

requirements.expected_failure_mode: only the top level of the input directory is read

requirements.expected_failure_mode: the method record is absent, incomplete, or uses the wrong codes
requirements.summary: Every released file says Patient Identity Removed YES and records the profile and both options by code.
